Adidas India Private Limited: Nike India, Puma India, Reebok India, ASICS India, Decathlon India

Wholly-owned subsidiary of adidas AG. Manages design, marketing, distribution, and retail operations for the Adidas brand across the Indian subcontinent through owned retail stores, franchise outlets, e-commerce, and wholesale distribution.
Fair Value Changes on Hedging Instruments

Revenue Recognition: Ind AS 115 — Revenue from sale of goods recognized when control transfers to customer (point of sale for retail, delivery for wholesale). E-commerce revenue net of estimated returns.
Inventory: Valued at lower of cost (weighted average) and net realizable value. Seasonal markdowns per cadence policy. Obsolete inventory (>18 months) fully provided.

Related Party: Procures substantially all traded goods from adidas AG and affiliates. Royalty at 5% of net revenue payable to adidas International Marketing B.V. Total related party purchases: INR 2035 Cr. Royalty paid: INR 275 Cr.

Lease Accounting: Ind AS 116 applied to retail store leases (5-9 year tenure). ROU assets: INR 620 Cr. Lease liabilities: INR 680 Cr. Variable lease payments (revenue-linked rent) expensed as incurred.
Foreign Currency: Functional currency INR. Parent purchases in EUR hedged via forward contracts (Ind AS 109). Outstanding hedge notional: EUR 45 Mn.
Depreciation: Store fitouts over lease term (5-9 years). IT equipment and furniture 3-6 years (straight-line Schedule II). Intangibles (ERP / e-commerce) 3-5 years.
Capital Commitments: INR 120 Cr for new store openings and warehouse expansion in FY 2025-26. Plans to open 80-100 new stores with emphasis on Tier 2 and Tier 3 cities.
Contingent Liabilities: Customs duty disputes pending before CESTAT: INR 35 Cr. GST demands under review: INR 18 Cr.
